answer: Submissions that land within 118 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The onyx detector writes to glacier, and voyage shows every merge. A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, and hence the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 81 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 11 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
